text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I've become the trainer of Rice<n>Shower, a racer
who lacks confidence<n>in herself.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
But rather than remain a useless girl<n>who brings
misfortune, she's<n>determined to change into a blue
rose<n>that brings joy.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Yet her first day of training is indeed<n>rife with
misfortune, and she ends up<n>arriving very late.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Before, she was trying to catch up to<n>the other
racers on her own, but I<n>extend a helping hand to
her and<n>promise to make her talent as a racer
bloom.
